claims.statement: The Republican interviewed Tom Allen at his hostelry on Washington Avenue, by the tunnel in St. Louis (the text says hostelry, not saloon).
claims.excerpt: we came to che well-known hostelry of Sir Thomas de Al-

claims.statement: Tom Allen calls himself champion of the twenty-four-foot-roped prize ring of the United States.
claims.excerpt: whereot he calieth himself the champion of

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he came to St. Louis to live and means to stay there.
claims.excerpt: I came here to live, and I’m going to stay here

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he sides with the legislature's bill against prize-fighting, because the ring has become corrupt.
claims.excerpt: Iside with the legislature about this bill against prize-tightine

claims.statement: Tom Allen said the bill had put his name in to mark him, and that the Times called him a refugee, which he denied.
claims.excerpt: they put my name in It to mark me

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards were coming to St. Louis about March 7 to give sparring exhibitions at Deagle's for a week, to test the bill.
claims.excerpt: Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards are cowing on here about the 7th of March

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Arthur Chambers had seconded him in an earlier fight.
claims.excerpt: As for Chambers— you remember him seconding me—he’s a Man-

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole; the reporter says that fight 'stands for nothing'.
claims.excerpt: The McCoole fight stands for nothing. He was a big traud

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I think it’s unnecessary and uncalled for in this state.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: It’s not the fighting meu that’s to blame and that break up the contidence. Its the gang that follow the ring.
quotes.topic: the gang that follows the ring, not the fighters

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I’m no refugee; I can go back whenever [ want to go.

fights.notes: Mentioned as a past fight ('the conqueror of the McCoole'). The win is from that phrase. The date is in 044.

notes: Interview at Allen's hostelry on the day before printing. The bill and the Chambers/Edwards exhibitions are Allen's talk about the law, not his own bouts.
